lib/astro_image_io/tests/p1hips/p1hips_t.text:
#define P1HIPS_CHECK_MSG(cs, cond, faultname, ...)                         \
    do {                                                                   \
        if ((cs).fault_reported && (faultname) != nullptr) {               \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        } else if (faultname != nullptr &&                                 \
                   p1hips::FaultRegistry::instance().injected(faultname)) { \
            (cs).note_injected(faultname);                                 \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        } else if (!(cond)) {                                              \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "CHECK failed %s:%d: %s — ",              \
                         __FILE__, __LINE__, #cond);                       \
            std::fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__);                             \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "\n");                                    \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        }                                                                  \
    } while (0)

#define P1HIPS_CHECK_EQ(cs, got, want)                                     \
    do {                                                                   \
        const long long g_ = (long long)(got);                             \
        const long long w_ = (long long)(want);                            \
        if (!(g_ == w_)) {                                                 \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "CHECK failed %s:%d: got=%lld want=%lld (%s)\n", \
                         __FILE__, __LINE__,                             \
                         static_cast<long long>(g_),                     \
                         static_cast<long long>(w_), #got);              \
            ++(cs).failures;                                             \
        }                                                                  \
    } while (0)

tests/unit/p1wcs/p1wcs_test_main.hpp.text:
#define P1WCS_CHECK_NEAR(cs, got, want, tol, faultname)                    \
    do {                                                                   \
        const double g_ = (got), w_ = (want), t_ = (tol);                  \
        if (p1wcs::FaultRegistry::instance().injected(faultname)) {        \
            (cs).note_injected(faultname);                                 \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        } else if (!((g_ - w_) <= t_ && (w_ - g_) <= t_)) {                \
            std::fprintf(stderr,                                        \
                         "CHECK failed %s:%d: %s got=%.12g want=%.12g tol=%.3g\n", \
                         __FILE__, __LINE__, #got, g_, w_, t_);            \
            ++(cs).failures;                                               \
        }                                                                  \
    } while (0)
